facts.claim: The carnival site's 2020 and 2022 news pages describe the Volo dell'Angelo as a tradition in which the previous edition's winning Maria descends from the campanile into St Mark's Square, and the 2022 notice says it was not held that year because of pandemic restrictions; the 2027 site does not mention it.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: descends from the campanile into the Square
not held in 2022 because of pandemic restrictions

facts.claim: The Enjoy Respect Venezia guidance on the carnival site says St Mark's Square is a protected historic site, asks visitors not to sit on the ground or eat and drink on monuments, church steps, bridges, wells and quaysides, and lists fines of EUR 25-500 and possible removal for breaking local rules; it publishes no carnival-specific access rules for the Square for 2027.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: says the Square is a protected historic site
lists fines of €25 to €500

facts.claim: Venice's imposta di soggiorno for hotels, per person per night: high season 1 February-31 December in the historic centre and Giudecca is EUR 1.00 / 2.00 / 3.50 / 4.50 / 5.00 for 1-5 stars; low season 1-31 January is EUR 0.70 / 1.40 / 2.40 / 3.10 / 3.50; mainland (Mestre) high season EUR 0.70 / 1.40 / 2.40 / 3.10 / 3.50 and January EUR 0.50 / 1.00 / 1.70 / 2.20 / 2.40; Lido and islands four-star EUR 3.60 high season and EUR 2.50 January; B&B/holiday flats (lions) EUR 2-5 in the centre in high season, 30% less in January. Table valid from 1 April 2025.

sources.title: City of Venice: imposta di soggiorno rates (PDF)

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: costs €3.10 per person per night until 31 January and €4.50 after
a four-star there pays €2.50 in January and €3.60 from 1 February
January is low season, and high season runs from 1 February to 31 December

facts.note: Table is valid from 1 April 2025; check the Comune page for a 2027 schedule.

facts.claim: Venice's tourist tax exempts children under 10 (not yet 10) and applies only to the first five nights of a stay.

sources.title: City of Venice: imposta di soggiorno rates (PDF), exemptions page

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: Children under 10 are exempt, and the tax stops after five nights

facts.claim: Editorial arithmetic from the city's table: a couple staying four nights 5-9 February pays 4 x 2 x EUR 4.50 = EUR 36 in a four-star in the historic centre and 4 x 2 x EUR 3.10 = EUR 24.80 in a four-star in Mestre; four nights 29 January-2 February (three January nights at EUR 3.10, one at EUR 4.50, each person) comes to EUR 27.60 for two, assuming each night is charged at the rate for its own date.

sources.title: City of Venice: imposta di soggiorno rates (PDF)

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: pays 4 × 2 × €4.50 = €36 in tax
€27.60 in all

facts.claim: The City of Venice's council (giunta) approved the 2027 access-fee (contributo di accesso) calendar on 15 October 2026: 72 days from Good Friday 26 March to 15 August 2027, 8.30am-4.30pm, maximum fee EUR 10, with none in January or February; exclusions/exemptions, booking and payment rules still to be set.

sources.title: City of Venice access fee site (cda.ve.it)
Comune di Venezia: Contributo di accesso, la Giunta approva il calendario 2027
La Voce di Venezia: calendario 2027, 72 giornate

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: 72 days from Good Friday, 26 March, to 15 August, with a maximum fee of €10
None of those days falls in January or February

facts.note: The Comune's own pages (cda.ve.it, live.comune.venezia.it) are behind bot protection and could not be opened by script; the claim was taken from the Comune's release as shown in search extracts and confirmed in La Voce di Venezia, Nordest24 and QdP. facts.claim: The 2026 access-fee trial applied on selected days between 3 April and 26 July 2026 (60 days per the city's 2026 scheme) and has ended.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: The 2026 trial ran on 60 days between 3 April and 26 July and has ended

facts.claim: Alilaguna's airport-Venice boat costs EUR 18 single and EUR 32 return, with one heavy bag and one hand luggage included; the Blue Line calls at Murano, Lido, Arsenale, San Zaccaria, San Marco, Zattere and the railway station, the Orange Line at Madonna dell'Orto, Guglie, San Stae, Rialto, Sant'Angelo, Ca' Rezzonico and Santa Maria del Giglio, and the Red Line is marked summer seasonal.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: Alilaguna runs to the historic centre for €18 one way or €32 return
Its Red Line is marked summer seasonal

facts.claim: ACTV/AVM standard 75-minute Rete Unica ticket EUR 9.50; passes EUR 25 (1 day, Venezia Daily Pass), EUR 35 (2 days), EUR 45 (3 days), EUR 65 (7 days); Aerobus 75-minute ticket EUR 10, return EUR 18, Aerobus plus 90-minute Rete Unica EUR 18; Mestre Daily Pass EUR 5 (app only) covers the mainland bus and tram network and Trenitalia regional trains within the municipality.

sources.title: AVM: Venice urban services and fares

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: a single ACTV ticket costs €9.50 and lasts 75 minutes
Passes cost €25 for a day, €35 for two, €45 for three and €65 for seven
the city's Mestre Daily Pass, €5 on its app

facts.claim: ATVO's Venice Airport Bus Express page lists unlimited baggage and says the bus stops are at exit D, stop no. 3 for Venice and stop no. 4 for Mestre.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: stop 3 for Venice and stop 4 for Mestre, with no limit on baggage

facts.claim: Gondola ferries (traghetti) cross the Grand Canal at Santa Sofia, San Tomà, Santa Maria del Giglio and Punta della Dogana and cost EUR 2.00 for tourists (EUR 0.70 for Venezia Unica residents); the historic centre has no roads and bicycles are prohibited, even when pushed.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: cost €2 for visitors and run from Santa Sofia, San Tomà, Santa Maria del Giglio and Punta della Dogana
bicycles are prohibited, even pushed

facts.claim: Hotel Concordia is a four-star in Venice with 51 rooms in a 17th-century Venetian house, run by the Beggiato family for four generations; it says it is the only hotel overlooking Piazza San Marco and that most rooms look onto the basilica's spires and mosaics.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A four-star of 51 rooms in a 17th-century Venetian house
the only hotel overlooking Piazza San Marco

facts.claim: Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal is at San Marco 1332 in Palazzo Dandolo, site of the Ridotto (1638), which its own history says became a theatre of masks and gambling for six months of each year, during Carnival; rooms run from the 22 sqm Golden Leaf room to the 50 sqm Casanova Alcove.

sources.title: Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal: official site
Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal: rooms and suites

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: At San Marco 1332, in Palazzo Dandolo
from the 22 m² Golden Leaf to the 50 m² Casanova Alcove

facts.claim: Hotel Metropole is a five-star at Riva degli Schiavoni 4149 next to the Pieta church, with Piazza San Marco 5 minutes' walk away by its count; its spa has a heated pool (37 C in winter) and hammam, 90 minutes of exclusive use costs EUR 200 per two people, and its offers page lists Christmas and New Year's packages but no Carnival offer.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A five-star on Riva degli Schiavoni 4149
90 minutes of exclusive use is €200 for two

facts.claim: Hotel Paganelli is a three-star superior at Riva degli Schiavoni 4182 with views of the San Marco basin and San Giorgio, rooftop terraces, 24-hour reception, a lift and the Sestante osteria; its page puts the San Zaccaria stop about 50 metres away.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A three-star superior at Riva degli Schiavoni 4182
the San Zaccaria stop about 50 metres away

facts.claim: Ca' Sagredo Hotel is a 15th-century palace at Campo Santa Sofia by the Ca' d'Oro, declared a national monument, with a frescoed ballroom, 42 rooms and suites and the L'Alcova restaurant on the Grand Canal opposite the Rialto Market; it also markets itself for weddings, parties and events.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A 15th-century palace at Campo Santa Sofia
42 rooms and suites

facts.claim: Hotel Abbazia is a three-star at Calle Priuli dei Cavaletti, Cannaregio 68, in a former Discalced Carmelite abbey about 100 metres from Santa Lucia station with no bridges to cross on the way, and a garden.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: Calle Priuli dei Cavaletti 68
about a hundred metres from Santa Lucia

facts.claim: Combo Venezia is a hostel in the former Convento dei Crociferi at Campo dei Gesuiti, Cannaregio 4878, a few steps from Rialto and the fish market, with 255 beds, all rooms ensuite, and a 24/7 reception.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: with 255 beds in twin rooms, lofts, studios and shared rooms
a few steps from Rialto and its fish market

facts.claim: Hotel American Dinesen is a four-star boutique hotel at Dorsoduro 628 on the San Vio canal with a 24-hour concierge, cocktail bar, terrace and water mooring; its room list names Classic, Superior & Canal View and Dependance categories.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A four-star boutique hotel at Dorsoduro 628
a Dependance and a Canal View category

facts.claim: Hotel Pensione Accademia is a three-star superior in Villa Maravege, a 17th-century residence at Fondamenta Bollani 1058, with two gardens, family run for over thirty years; it counts 12 minutes to La Fenice and 15 to St Mark's Square, its Basic Double is 12 sqm and the historic building has no elevator.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: La Fenice is 12 minutes away and St Mark's Square 15
the Basic Double rooms are 12 m²

facts.claim: Generator Venice is a hostel in a former warehouse at Fondamenta Zitelle 86 on Giudecca with a 24-hour reception, bar, terrace and female-only dorms; it says every room has a view of the gardens, the Lido, the Grand Canal or Piazza San Marco, and that vaporetto lines 2 and 4.1 stop at Zitelle, 100 metres away.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: at Fondamenta Zitelle 86
lines 2 and 4.1 a hundred metres away

facts.claim: Hotel Plaza is a four-star of 209 rooms facing Venice Mestre station, which it says is less than 10 minutes by train from Venice island and 17 minutes by bus from the airport.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A four-star of 209 rooms facing Venice Mestre station

facts.claim: Anda Venice Hostel is at Via Ortigara 10, Mestre, 200 metres from Mestre station, with mixed and female dorms of 6, 7 and 9 beds (ensuite) and ensuite doubles; it puts Venice a 10-minute train or bus ride away and offers 10% off and a free drink for direct bookings.

articles/where-to-stay-in-venice-carniva: A design hostel at Via Ortigara 10
10% off and a drink
